name: Inda no Yokujoku Haha ~Ayano~
source:
Ayano lost her husband and is now living with her son, Yuuichi.
She kept dreaming of the life she had with her husband.

*Chapter 1 While My Son is Out...
One day, she was violated by her father-in-law who was visiting... but somehow, her instinct as a sexual woman was awakened.

*Chapter 2 With My Son
After her sexual instinct was awakened, she decided to accept her son's favor, who came to ask her for sex.
She is turning into a complete sex addict...and asking more from her own son.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046599.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
绫野失去了丈夫，现在和儿子雄一住在一起。
她一直梦想着与丈夫的生活。

*第一章当我儿子外出时……
某天，她被来访的公公强暴了……但不知为何，她身为性女人的本能被唤醒了。

*第二章和我儿子
当她的性本能被唤醒后，她决定接受儿子的求爱。
她正在变成一个彻底的性瘾者……并对自己的儿子要求更多。
